question: The July 1991 industrial reforms are particularly associated with:

options.A: Reduction of industrial licensing and public-sector reservation

option_review.A: SUPPORTED: 24 July 1991 Statement on Industrial Policy para 23 and Decisions of Government A(i)-(ii) abolished industrial licensing for most industries while retaining specified exceptions and public-sector reservation in strategic areas; Public Sector D(i) envisaged selective opening.
option_review.B: INCORRECT: First Five Year Plan dates to 1951-56, not July 1991; not a reform described in the 1991 policy statement.
option_review.C: INCORRECT: Statement retains compulsory licensing exceptions, location/environment rules and other regulation; does not abolish all financial regulation.
option_review.D: INCORRECT: Planning Commission was established in 1950, not created by the 1991 industrial policy.
